# sendgrid_template_mail_settings (Resource)

Manages the account-wide legacy email template mail setting, which wraps every outgoing email in custom HTML. This is a singleton: SendGrid has exactly one legacy template configuration per account (or per subuser, via the provider's `on_behalf_of`); creating this resource updates that configuration in place, and destroying it only removes it from Terraform state without resetting SendGrid's setting.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sendgrid_template_mail_settings" "this" {
  enabled      = true
  html_content = "<% body %>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the legacy email template mail setting is enabled.

### Optional

- `html_content` (String) The custom HTML content for the legacy email template. Must contain the `<% body %>` tag, or the original email body will not be included.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `template_mail_settings`.
